# sonarqube_apply_permission_template (Action)

Applies a permission template to existing projects, replacing their permissions with the template's. SonarQube applies templates only when a project is created, so changes to a template (e.g. a `sonarqube_permission_template` or its permissions) do not reach existing projects without this action. Choose the projects with exactly one of `projects`, `search` or `all_projects`. Do not apply a template to projects whose permissions `sonarqube_permissions` manages: the next plan would undo it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Re-apply the template to existing projects whenever its permissions change:
# terraform apply -invoke=action.sonarqube_apply_permission_template.internal
# runs it on demand.
action "sonarqube_apply_permission_template" "internal" {
  config {
    template = sonarqube_permission_template.internal.name
    search   = "internal-"
  }
}

resource "terraform_data" "internal_template" {
  input = [sonarqube_permissions.internal_developers.permissions]

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.sonarqube_apply_permission_template.internal]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template` (String) Permission template name.

### Optional

- `all_projects` (Boolean) Set to `true` to apply the template to every project.
- `projects` (Set of String) Keys of the projects.
- `search` (String) Projects whose name contains this text, or whose key is exactly this text.
